"""Pinned TF 4.46.3 synthetic references; no original checkpoint downloads."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from transformers import (
    CLIPConfig, CLIPTextConfig, CLIPVisionConfig, TFCLIPModel,
    ViTConfig, TFViTModel, RobertaConfig, TFRobertaForSequenceClassification,
)

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
common = dict(hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=2,
              num_attention_heads=4, hidden_dropout_prob=0.0, attention_probs_dropout_prob=0.0)
text = CLIPTextConfig(**common, vocab_size=32, max_position_embeddings=32,
                      bos_token_id=0, eos_token_id=2, pad_token_id=1)
vision = CLIPVisionConfig(**common, image_size=16, patch_size=4)
clip = CLIPConfig(text_config=text.to_dict(), vision_config=vision.to_dict(), projection_dim=16)
cases = [
    ('clip', TFCLIPModel, clip, dict(input_ids=np.array([[0,7,8,2],[0,9,2,1]],np.int32),
            attention_mask=np.array([[1,1,1,1],[1,1,1,0]],np.int32),
            pixel_values=np.linspace(-1,1,768,dtype=np.float32).reshape(1,3,16,16))),
    ('vit', TFViTModel, ViTConfig(**common,image_size=16,patch_size=4),
            dict(pixel_values=np.linspace(-1,1,768,dtype=np.float32).reshape(1,3,16,16))),
    ('roberta', TFRobertaForSequenceClassification, RobertaConfig(**common,vocab_size=32,
            max_position_embeddings=34,num_labels=3,type_vocab_size=1,pad_token_id=1,
            id2label={0:'negative',1:'neutral',2:'positive'},
            label2id={'negative':0,'neutral':1,'positive':2}),
            dict(input_ids=np.array([[0,7,8,2],[0,9,2,1]],np.int32),
                 attention_mask=np.array([[1,1,1,1],[1,1,1,0]],np.int32))),
]
for index,(family,cls,config,inputs) in enumerate(cases):
    path=OUT/f'tiny-{family}';path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    model=cls(config)
    values={k:tf.constant(v) for k,v in inputs.items()}
    model(**values,training=False)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(6120+index)
    for variable in model.weights:
        value=rng.normal(0,0.03,variable.shape).astype(np.float32)
        if variable.name.endswith('gamma:0'):value+=1
        variable.assign(value)
    result=model(**values,training=False)
    model.save_pretrained(path,safe_serialization=False)
    fields={'clip':['logits_per_image','text_embeds','image_embeds'],
            'vit':['last_hidden_state','pooler_output'],'roberta':['logits']}[family]
    np.savez(path/'reference.npz',**inputs,**{k:getattr(result,k).numpy() for k in fields})
    (path/'weights.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'name':w.name,'shape':list(w.shape)} for w in model.weights],indent=2)+'\n')
    print(family,len(model.weights),flush=True)
